title: Multipath and fading
idea: When copies of a signal arrive by different paths, they add up or cancel. That's why signals flutter and fade.

lines: Move the antenna a few feet: the signal can swing from strong to weak
Driving: rapid flutter called picket fencing
HF: irregular fading as copies combine at random

traps.wrong: The signal path encounters different concentrations of water vapor
traps.why: A few feet doesn't change the air. It changes how the reflected copies combine.

traps.wrong: Alternating transmissions during a net operation
traps.why: Picket fencing is the rapid flutter on mobile signals from multipath.

traps.wrong: Frequency shift due to Faraday rotation
traps.why: Irregular fading comes from signals arriving by different paths and combining at random.

traps.wrong: No significant changes will occur if the signals are transmitted using FM
traps.why: FM doesn't escape it. Multipath makes data error rates go up.
